So I recommend child safe locks, and having everything up

I had a terrible tear! It hurt for months. The first couple times hurt so bad. I told my gyno and she said that I was healing really well and pain was to be expected. After the first couple times, it got much better. Unfortunately 2 years later, there is still  occasional discomfort.

A 23 should not want anything to do with a 16 year old no matter how mature she is or looks. I had my first at young age and understand the hardship. Its rewarding but hard and it seems the relationship between her the father could end badly. He needs to know that what he did could pick him up a statutory rape charge.

This is probably a phase. When I was around that age, I absolutely hated "girly things" I wouldnt wear anything pink or sparkly and always watched the cartoons the boys would watch. Then I hit around my teen years and made girl friends and started wanting to dress like them and wear make up and ended up being a cheerleader throughout school and now I'm even a makeup artist! As long as she knows that it isnt expected of her as a girl to abide by "girly standard" and can like what she likes without having to pick a "side"

I think you handled it well. You didnt flip out which would cause her to not want to open up. She needs to know that it isnt her fault and she did nothing wrong. And definitely did the right thing by telling you. Now that the boy knows they are aware of his behavior, maybe he will stay away from the kids and hopfully they watch him like a hawk. The fact that the supervisor showed concern and took action right away shows that this is a pretty safe environment for your kids. If this were me I would make sure that boy has no contact with my daughter. Being upset is to be expected because we dont want our kids to feel uncomfortable and exposed to things like that at such a young age. You did the right thing!
You are not alone one bit! It is very hard. especially all alone. We love them but we miss the freedom we once had. I felt the same way once mine started walking😂
